name: CAP-U10WALK2
question: The panel top while scrolling on the first section, and the mark through Undo and Redo.
answer: Down: section bottom - 475, once that is above where it opened, held at 0. Up: it stays until section top + 140 reaches it. 29 of 34 reads fit within 1 px. 5 run ahead on the way down, by 2.7 to 19.7 px, and they read the same 400 ms later, so they aren't reads in the middle of a move: no rule. The mark: Undo to an earlier pick marks nothing, Redo to a pick that isn't the last marks nothing, and reopening there marks it.
ours: sectionPanelTop with prev and the section's top + 143. The same 29 within 1.5 px, checked in marks.
pressed: Tiles and the View Layouts button by data-test with an on-top check (pressLayout, pressEl). Undo and Redo by name. Moves by coordinates, never a press. Selecting a block by its middle. Paste over the text the tool selected. Nothing saved: Exit Without Saving.
